groups.activity: pick Zenith at a weapon milestone (day 100, 300, 500 or 700)
groups.meta: earliest possible day 100; worst case day 500

rows.label: Zenith
rows.note: pick it first if you want to use it early

conditions: Login days are cumulative, not consecutive; missing days only delays the milestone, nothing resets.
The choice is final with no confirmation prompt; support will not roll back a wrong pick.
bonuses: Arrives fully built with its own weapon slot and an Orokin Catalyst pre-installed; no Foundry step.
Sigma & Octantis joins the day-100 pool at day 300, so the day-100 choice is only ever Azima, Zenistar or Zenith.

disclosures.title: replacement copy, not a shortcut
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells a Zenith Blueprint for 100,000 standing, but it only appears once you've already claimed one from a milestone. It replaces a sold copy and gives no extra Mastery.
